3210.title: Task lifecycle events perform tracker-wide scans
3210.rootCauseOneLine: The lifecycle event path filters one thread ID only after enumerating every task and querying each task's thread rows.
3210.proposedFix: Add an internal thread-ID lookup over the existing index and use it for lifecycle event transitions while preserving one-to-many task fan-out.
3210.caveats: The verified regression used three tasks rather than the larger tracker described by the reporter; the source loop proves one per-task query for any task count.
